incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high GPU queue growth in gcp-south2. Autoscaler failing to attach accelerators; observed DENY from GCP. On-call: @maria gonzalez. Please ack and triage.

maria gonzalez: acked. seeing long request queues for text-gen and embedding endpoints (~3-4k queued). Latency SLOs breached for some customers.

aj patel: :eyes: Confirming — dashboards show pool_util ~100%, attach_errors spiking. Here's the last error from autoscaler: `ERROR: AttachAccelerator failed: quotaExceeded for accelerators (type nvidia-t4) in project`.

ken wong: any chance this is project-level quota or region-global limit? I see failed GCE API calls returning 403 with body:```{"error": {"code": 403, "message": "Quota exceeded for resource 'accelerator' in region 'south2'", "status": "PERMISSION_DENIED"}}```

maria gonzalez: looks like project quota. We recently bumped warm pool but didn't request increased accelerator quota. Autoscaler keeps retrying but provider returns DENY so new nodes never come up. Queue keeps growing.

li zhao: impact: realtime-chat-prod (p99 > 2.4s, error rate 1.7%), embeddings-search (requests timing out at 30s). Rough customer list: cid-9873, cid-4421. Let's open customer comms once we have mitigation.

aj patel: immediate mitigations: 1) failover low-priority traffic to eu-west1 (start routing split), 2) reduce batch_size to lower GPU pressure, 3) enable CPU fallback for small inference jobs. I'll start the routing change.

ken wong: routing change command (internal):`POST https://console.internal/redwood/routing/splits -d '{"from":"gcp-south2","to":"eu-west1","percent":20,"routes":["realtime-chat-prod:low-prio","embeddings-search:bulk"]}'`

aj patel: applied 20% split for low-priority buckets. Monitoring... queue decreased ~8% in 2m.

maria gonzalez: good. Next: open support ticket with GCP quota team and attach our attach_error logs. @cloud-support-bot can you create the ticket and escalate? Use priority P0 for quota since it's customer impacting.

cloud-support-bot: Created ticket GCP-INC-63241. Filled with logs and request: "Increase accelerators (nvidia-t4) for project x-prod in region south2 from 200 -> 400". Link: https://console.cloudsupport/gcp-INC-63241

li zhao: also toggling autoscaler to use fallback model variant (quantized 4-bit) for batch-heavy routes to reduce per-request GPU. Pushing new rollout now.

maria gonzalez: rollout started to 15% canary for quantized model on realtime-chat-prod (small responses only). If stable, ramp.

ken wong: watchlist: attach_errors, pool_util, queue_len, region_latency. I'll update the runbook timeline.

aj patel: FYI: because quota DENY is deterministic, autoscaler backoff is causing repeated attempts and API noise. Setting autoscaler retry window to longer period to avoid extra API calls. Patching now.

maria gonzalez: customer impact note for ops: some customers saw increased latency and occasional 503s; no data plane security issues. will prepare short comms draft after status stabilizes.

li zhao: GCP responded to our ticket: provisional short-term quota bump approved to 320 accelerators within 45-60m; long-term request pending. If that lands, autoscaler should be able to attach and drain queue.

aj patel: once bump arrives we should unpause scaleup and trigger warm-pool attach. I'll monitor.

maria gonzalez: incident commander for now. Action items: (1) ken update runbook + timeline, (2) aj maintain routing split & autoscaler patch, (3) li finish canary and comms, (4) cloud-support-bot follow ticket.

ken wong: logged actions in incident doc https://internal/infra/incidents/6499998888 (will update with timeline).

cloud-support-bot: GCP ticket updated: quota increased to 320. Autoscaler now receiving attach success responses.

aj patel: confirmed capacity attaching; new nodes coming up. queue_len trending down from 4k -> 600 in 12m. Errors dropping.

maria gonzalez: beginning recovery verification. Keeping routing split at 10% for another 30m then revert if stable.

li zhao: customers impacted list prepared; drafting email to impacted accounts for post-incident summary.

maria gonzalez: thanks team. I'll close this thread after 4h stable and a postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
